summary: Tested return refund honoring invoice discount + manual refund override. Backend 9/9 pytest pass (single-item 15-3 => refund 12; manual 10; cap above max; negative clamped to 0; manual 0 restores stock; multi-item 10+20 disc 6 => 16 then remaining 8 capped; over-refund then remaining cap; debt sale 12 => debt 7 + cash 5 and customer balance to 0; phone IMEI back in_stock with 180 refund). UI (Rikthimet page search by invoice): item line shows 'Çmimi €15,00 · paguar €12,00 (me zbritje)', auto/input/big amount = 12.00, confirm saves 12 and list row shows €12; manual 10 saves 10; Auto reset restores 12; typing 50 is capped to €12. ONE FAILURE: manual refund 0 -> Konfirmo button stays disabled, so 'return item without money' is impossible from UI.

ui_bugs.issue: With quantity selected and manual refund typed as 0, submit button is disabled (disabled={saving || refund <= 0}). Requirement: manual 0 allowed. Fix: disable only when no quantity selected, e.g. const hasQty = Object.values(qty).some(q => Number(q) > 0); disabled={saving || !hasQty}.

action_items: ReturnDialog.jsx: enable return-submit-btn when any qty > 0 even if refund is 0 (backend already accepts refund_amount 0).
critical_code_review_comments: Frontend: if manual input is cleared (empty string) refund becomes 0 silently; consider treating empty as auto or showing hint.
Backend: line_refund = round(unit*factor,2)*qty not rounded after multiply; float artifacts possible for large qty (minor, final refund_total is rounded).
Returns page find() loads all /sales client-side to match invoice; fine for now, slow at scale.
